item.tib: bla chen yab sras gsum gyi gsol 'debs bar chod kun sel bsam 'grub nor bu
item.coloph: de ltar bla chen yab sras kyi gsol 'debs nyung 'dus 'di/ sprul sku blo ldan snying po'i ma 'ongs lung bstan las gsungs bzhin pa ltar/ 'di 'dra zhig brtsam dgos bsam pa'i dad pa sngon nas yod kyang / nye bar mgo ba klu skyobs yag gong ma'i pho brang du 'gro ba'i tshe/ bar chod kun sel gyi gsol 'debs shig dgos zhes bskul bas rkyen sbyar te/ 'chal gtam pa nam mkha' rgyal mtshan gyis sa yos zla ba lnga yi tshes bdun la mda' chen dkar mo ri khrod du yi ger bkod pas tha tshan mu tsug smar ro//
